description: This script manages LED status indicators during different system states such as preinit, failsafe, and upgrade, and restores triggers for LEDs based on device tree information.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the trigger for the status LED based on the device tree setting.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED indicator behavior based on system state such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, or done.
